outfit.name: 全能忠犬荷叶边女仆装
outfit.prose: classical French maid uniform: frilled white lace maid headdress, tailored black short-sleeved maid dress, crisp white ruffled apron tied in a large bow at the back, red ribbon bowtie at the collar, white frilled thigh-high stockings with garter straps, and black patent leather mary jane shoes
